mechanism.claim: When the final three canonical confirmation intervals have higher mean absolute BTC return per elapsed confirmation second than the first three while their returns share one strict sign, block-time price-discovery velocity is escalating; follow that common late direction for six elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of confirmation-interval returns 4, 5, and 6
mechanism.why_distinct: CLCVER computes each interval's absolute price response per elapsed confirmation second before comparing ladder halves. CLTCR required a strict ordering of three raw durations; CLBHAR compared unscaled early and late returns; CLSIER normalized by block weight. CLCVER reuses none of their event sets or controls and uses no fitted threshold.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: directional price discovery accompanied by escalating return-per-second velocity identifies unstable block-time repricing; causal RV20 q90 remains only a later audit
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: height-modulo anchors, six per-interval confirmation-velocity ratios, late return unanimity, and six-hour reservation form a sparse asynchronous clock

features.anchor: canonical height H divisible by 36; ladder is blocks H through H+6
features.ladder_intervals: six strictly increasing header-timestamp intervals (H+k-1,H+k], each 60 to 1800 seconds
features.completed_minutes: for each interval use exact complete UTC perpetual minutes whose opens are >=ceil(left/60)*60 and whose closes are <=floor(right/60)*60
features.interval_return: R_k=log(last completed-minute close/first completed-minute open), finite and strict nonzero
features.interval_duration: S_k is the header-time difference for interval k, integer in [60,1800] seconds
features.late_unanimity: R_4,R_5,R_6 have one common strict sign
features.confirmation_velocity: V_k=abs(R_k)/S_k for k=1..6, finite and strict positive
features.eligible_state: late unanimity and velocity escalation are both true
features.onset: current eligible state true and immediately preceding valid anchor state false; invalid anchors preserve prior valid state
features.confirmation: block H+6 is contained before signal availability
features.raw_availability: prefix maximum header timestamp and mediantime through H+6 plus 7200 seconds
features.decision: raw availability ceiled to the next exact five-minute UTC boundary D
features.source_valid: contiguous canonical chain and exact coherent perpetual minute grid, no imputation

rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean exact daily returns^2 over t-20 through t-1)
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear q90 over 756 strictly prior available RV20 observations
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: only after all sequential full-calendar stages pass

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition on causal RV20 q90 decisions

definitions.late_unanimity_only: late-three return unanimity onset without velocity escalation
definitions.velocity_only: velocity escalation onset without late-three unanimity; side is sign(L)
definitions.one_anchor_stale_ladder: primary valid-anchor state and side shifted one anchor before onset

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no block predicate, velocity formula, threshold, confirmation, embargo, side, clock, hold, RV20, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
